detail.longDescription: MIT's CSAIL and the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, led by Jim Glass, have been diagnosing where multimodal foundation models fail. The work covers object localization and audio understanding, plus lightly supervised fixes that need little or no new labelled data. The article also covers IPLoc, OmniR1 and a coming focus on full-duplex spoken dialogue. # MultimodalAI # MachineLearning # AIResearch https:// mlhub.blog/news/mit-and-ibm-pr obe-the-blind-spots-in-multimodal-ai-d43c6x9o/
